faults.title: Software-related electronic glitches (Mk4)
faults.description: Auto Express says electronics are the most common owner complaint on the 2020-on Mk4 A3, usually caused by software rather than a failed part. Test all the screens and systems.

faults.title: Power supply and brake recalls (Mk4)
faults.description: Over 100,000 Mk4 A3s built March 2020 to May 2023 were recalled in August 2023 for potentially faulty power supplies. There were also recalls for faulty fuses on plug-in hybrids and a part that could cause loss of braking.

faults.title: 1.4 TFSI wastegate rattle (Mk3)
faults.description: Some early Mk3 (2012-2020) 1.4 TFSI engines rattle under acceleration because the wastegate actuator rod vibrates.

faults.title: Leaking water pump (Mk3)
faults.description: Some Mk3 owners have had water pumps leak, causing the coolant level to drop. Look for puddles under the car.

faults.title: Creaking pop-up MMI screen (Mk3)
faults.description: The Mk3's retractable infotainment screen can creak as it slides out of the dash. The mechanism may need lubricating or replacing.
